_comment: First-party Quark compat (QUARKISLANDPLAN #71) — jasper + shale + a rare deep blue-corundum geode on the deepslate-bodied ancient mining island, plus myalite on the End form. Extras only, no dedicated seed. Inert without Quark. The overworld biome_override bands re-add the Quark veins into ancient's deep (max_y:20) and high (min_y:96) Y-bands, which otherwise REPLACE the top-level ore list — without them the stones only appeared at Y 20-96. Selectors match ancient.json exactly so they MERGE (append).

biome_overrides._comment: End form: myalite veins the end-stone island (see quark_rocky.json). Empty-biomes + dimension the_end selector-merges into ancient's base End band.
Merge the Quark veins into the deep band (max_y 20) — else it replaces the ore list.
